## Acceptance evidence

Reference the PBI's stable acceptance IDs and link the commands, observations or artifacts that demonstrate each. Do not copy the issue shape or the full OpenSpec specification.

## Scope and decisions

Name deviations from the PBI's Seam, unresolved dependencies and open decisions. Update the authoritative issue shape when it changes; this PR is not a second source of truth.

## Review boundary

Name the candidate commit and what was actually verified. Input validation, a passing command and this template do not grant approval, release a Hold or authorize merge.
